cases.question: average speed per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: how many readings per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, COUNT(*) AS reading_count FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: what was the highest wave height
cases.sql: SELECT MAX(wave_height) AS highest_wave_height FROM telemetry

cases.question: average water temperature across the fleet
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(water_temp) AS avg_water_temp FROM telemetry

cases.question: minimum and maximum speed for each vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, MIN(speed) AS min_speed, MAX(speed) AS max_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: hourly average wind speed over the last 2 days
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '2 days' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

cases.question: max wave height per vessel per day
cases.reason: right values, column roles out of order (day, vessel, max_wave_height)
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day, MAX(wave_height) AS max_wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel, day ORDER BY day, vessel

cases.question: daily minimum and maximum water temperature
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day, MIN(water_temp) AS min_temp, MAX(water_temp) AS max_temp FROM telemetry GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

cases.question: Aurora's average speed in 15-minute buckets over the last day
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '15 minutes', ts) as time, avg(speed) as avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

cases.question: average wind per vessel in six-hour buckets
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '6 hours', ts) AS ts, vessel, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY ts, vessel ORDER BY ts, vessel

cases.question: average speed by hour of day
cases.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ts) AS hour_of_day, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY hour_of_day ORDER BY hour_of_day

cases.question: average wave height by day of the week
cases.sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', ts) AS day, wave_height
FROM telemetry
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day
LIMIT 5000

cases.question: water temperature trend for Aurora in the last week
cases.sql:
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day, vessel, AVG(water_temp) AS avg_water_temp
FROM telemetry
WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY day, vessel
ORDER BY day, vessel

cases.question: which vessel was fastest on average in the last 24 hours
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY avg_speed DESC

cases.question: compare wave height of all vessels by hour over the last 12 hours
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '12 hours' GROUP BY hour, vessel ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: mean speed for the last 30 minutes in one-minute buckets
cases.sql:
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', ts) AS time, vessel, AVG(speed) AS mean_speed
FROM telemetry
WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
GROUP BY time, vessel
ORDER BY time, vessel

cases.question: Average wind from September 3 to September 5, 2026, hourly
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-03 00:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-06 00:00:00' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

cases.question: Average wave height for the last hour in one-minute buckets
cases.sql:
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', ts) AS minute, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height
FROM telemetry
WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 hour'
GROUP BY minute
ORDER BY minute

cases.question: compare speed of Kestrel and Nomad by hour
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) as hour, vessel, AVG(speed) as avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel IN ('Kestrel', 'Nomad') GROUP BY hour, vessel ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: Compare vessel speed by hour over the last day excluding Aurora
cases.sql:
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
FROM telemetry
WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day'
  AND vessel <> 'Aurora'
GROUP BY hour, vessel
ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: how many readings had waves above 4 metres, per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, COUNT(*) AS reading_count FROM telemetry WHERE wave_height > 4 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Hourly average speed for vessels north of latitude 50 in the last day
cases.sql:
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
FROM telemetry
WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day'
  AND lat > 50
GROUP BY hour, vessel
ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: Show hourly wind for Poseidon over the last 7 days
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) as hour, AVG(wind) as avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Poseidon' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour LIMIT 1000

cases.question: in how many hours did Solstice see wind above 30 knots
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ts) / 60.0 AS hours FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Solstice' AND wind > 30

cases.question: table of the 10 highest hourly average wave heights
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) as hour, round(avg(wave_height), 2) as avg_wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY hour ORDER BY avg_wave_height DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: the three fastest vessels by average speed in the past 7 days
cases.sql:
SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
FROM telemetry
WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-07 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY vessel
ORDER BY avg_speed DESC
LIMIT 3

cases.question: which day had the strongest average wind
cases.sql: SELECT DATE(ts) as day, AVG(wind) as avg_wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY day ORDER BY avg_wind DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: which vessel recorded the coldest water
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, MIN(water_temp) AS min_water_temp FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY min_water_temp LIMIT 1

cases.question: which vessel got farthest east
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, MAX(lon) AS max_lon FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY max_lon DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: correlation between wind and speed per vessel
cases.sql:
SELECT vessel, CORR(wind, speed) AS wind_speed_corr
FROM telemetry
GROUP BY vessel
ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: difference between maximum and minimum water temperature per vessel
cases.sql:
SELECT vessel, MAX(water_temp) - MIN(water_temp) as temp_diff
FROM telemetry
GROUP BY vessel
ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Compare speed and wave height by hour over the last 7 days
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) as hour, avg(speed) as avg_speed, avg(wave_height) as avg_wave_height FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

cases.question: Average ratio of wave height to wind speed per hour over the last day
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, AVG(wave_height / wind) AS ratio FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour LIMIT 24

cases.question: average speed of each vessel in km/h over the last day
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) * 1.852 AS avg_speed_km_h FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: average speed per vessel in the first week versus the second week
cases.sql:
SELECT vessel, time_bucket(INTERVAL '7 days', ts) AS week, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
FROM telemetry
WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-15 00:00:00'
GROUP BY vessel, week
ORDER BY week, vessel

cases.question: latest position of every vessel
cases.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (vessel) ts, vessel, lat, lon
FROM telemetry
ORDER BY vessel, ts DESC

cases.question: where was Meridian yesterday
cases.sql: SELECT ts, lat, lon FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Meridian' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-13 00:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 00:00:00' ORDER BY ts LIMIT 100

cases.question: show all vessel tracks on a map
cases.sql:
SELECT vessel, ts, lat, lon
FROM telemetry
ORDER BY vessel, ts

cases.question: how many readings were taken north of 50 degrees latitude, per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, COUNT(*) AS reading_count FROM telemetry WHERE lat > 50 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Aurora's average position per day
cases.sql:
SELECT DATE(ts) AS day, AVG(lat) AS avg_lat, AVG(lon) AS avg_lon
FROM telemetry
WHERE vessel = 'Aurora'
GROUP BY DATE(ts)
ORDER BY day

cases.question: average wave height per ves
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: wind
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, AVG(wind) as avg_wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: speed last week
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day, AVG(speed) AS speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

cases.question: scatter of wind vs wave height
cases.sql: SELECT wind, wave_height FROM telemetry ORDER BY wind, wave_height LIMIT 5000
